articles.title: Crypto exchanges Binance, Coinbase join West Africa scam sweep that flagged $11 million
articles.snippet: Private-sector partners flagged $11 million in funds that could be frozen, while officials reported cryptocurrency seizures without disclosing their value.

articles.title: ‘Terrifying Precedent’: Dutch Hand US Data From Seized Anti-Fascist Server
articles.snippet: Police seized the Autistici/Inventati server under a 1981 treaty after the U.S. designated the Italian activist group “global terrorists.”

articles.title: Three Canadian Armed Forces Members Charged in Kidnapping of Crypto Exchange Owner
articles.snippet: Police seized guns, silencers and more than 2,000 rounds of ammunition, nearly all of it allegedly stolen from the Canadian military.
